title: Consent and mode routing correctly differentiates doctor vs conversation mode

test_cases.name: Mode enum defines doctor and conversation variants
test_cases.expected_result: Mode.doctor and Mode.conversation exist with distinct values

test_cases.name: PipelineContext.is_conversation() correctly detects mode
test_cases.input_setup: Create PipelineContext with Mode.doctor and Mode.conversation
test_cases.expected_result: is_conversation() = False for doctor, True for conversation
test_cases.evidence: is_conversation returns False for doctor, True for conversation

test_cases.name: Extraction prompt differs between doctor and conversation modes
test_cases.expected_result: Prompts are different; conversation prompt references dialogue/conversation
test_cases.evidence: Extraction prompts differ between doctor and conversation modes

test_cases.name: is_arabic() correctly differentiates language contexts
test_cases.expected_result: is_arabic()=True for Arabic, False for English
